classified.title: Plano de las excavaciones hechas en el sitio de Numancia (Lám. IV, fig. 5, Saavedra 1879; excavations of 1853/1855)

files.desc: Lám. IV (leaf 507) of Eduardo Saavedra, 'Descripción de la vía romana de Úxama á Augustóbriga', RAH Memorias de la Real Academia de la Historia tomo IX, printed 1879, Madrid; rendered locally from the Internet Archive volume scan (item memoriasdelareal009real, 300 ppi) - the item has no per-leaf image. Numancia (Numantia), the Roman city at the Cerro de la Muela near Soria, Spain. Fig. 5 (scale 1/1000): the excavation plan of Numancia from Saavedra's 1853/1855 campaign: the hatched dig area on the hill slope, the excavated room-structure with its rubble field, the dashed survey grid, section A-B ('Corte por A B'), 'Monumento hallado'. The same plate carries figs 1-2 (the Calatañazor rock tombs, the ermita of the Mártires de Garray, 1/300), fig 3 (the 'Muro de Numancia', alzado 5 / corte 4, 1/300) and figs 7-8 (the Augustóbriga walls and a wall-section, 1/300 and 1/1000). Lith. J. Domm. Madrid. Public domain: printed 1879, author d. c. 1902; the IA item carries no license field.
